info.title: Rho API
info.description:
Programmatic access to Rho's banking, spend, and treasury primitives -
accounts, cards, payments, and the transaction ledger.

All endpoints take a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. See
the [Authentication](/docs/v1/auth) and [Pagination](/docs/v1/pagination)
guides to get started. Errors follow
[RFC 9457 problem details](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457.html);
timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC; monetary amounts are integers in the
smallest currency unit.

Beta-tagged v1 resources may change with notice. Untagged, generally
available resources are additive-only, and breaking changes require a new
API version. See the
[versioning policy](/docs/v1/versioning).

tags.name: Business
tags.description:
Returns the profile of the business the calling token is connected to.
The business is resolved from the token; the caller does not pass a
business identifier.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description:
Accounts represent the balances a business holds with Rho - checking,
savings, credit, investment, and rewards. Endpoints in this group let
you list every account the business has access to and
fetch a single account's current balance, identifiers, and metadata.
All amounts are denominated in the account's currency and reflect the
latest posted activity.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description:
Cards are the physical and virtual payment cards belonging to the
business. Endpoints in this group list cards and fetch a
single card's identity, cardholder, lifecycle status, spending limits,
current spend, usage dates, addresses, and merchant restrictions.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description:
Transactions cover the full money-movement lifecycle on a Rho
account - card spend, ACH credits and debits, wires, transfers,
refunds, and fees. Endpoints in this group return paginated activity
with rich filtering (by account, type, status, date range, search
text) and let you drill into a single transaction's posting state,
counterparty, and audit trail.

tags.name: Statements
tags.description:
Statements are the finalized, period-end documents Rho issues for a
business - spanning checking, savings, treasury, and credit. Each record
carries the period boundaries, a short-lived link to the PDF, and a
per-account breakdown of opening and closing balances and period totals;
account and treasury statements may cover multiple accounts, while credit
statements carry a single entry. Reconciliation partners can ingest every
account in one aggregated, paginated surface. Statement period boundaries
are calendar dates (not timestamps): statements are day-grained,
point-in-time documents with no sub-day precision.

tags.name: Invoicing
tags.description:
Invoicing covers issued invoices and the customers they are billed to.
Endpoints return invoice lifecycle and accounting-sync state, customer
records, applied payments, and invoice PDFs.

tags.name: Insights
tags.description: Understand how money moves into and out of your business.

tags.name: Users
tags.description:
Users are the people on your business. Endpoints in this group list
every member of the business and return a single member's profile,
membership status, and account status.

tags.name: Reimbursements
tags.description:
Reimbursements are the out-of-pocket and mileage requests your team
members submit to be paid back. Endpoints in this group list requests
with their amounts, merchants, coding fields, and approval and payment
state, and return a fresh signed download URL for a receipt.

tags.name: Expenses
tags.description:
Corporate card expense reads, with approval states, policy compliance,
coding tags, and receipt attachments.

tags.name: Credit
tags.description:
Credit covers the live state of a business's credit with Rho - program
terms such as repayment cadence, cashback rate, and credit limit, plus a
point-in-time balance snapshot with available credit, settled and pending
balances, and repayment dates.

tags.name: Scheduled Transactions
tags.description:
Scheduled transactions are future-dated payments and transfers - committed
but not yet released. They include one-time and recurring schedules, bill
payments, and plain transfers. The transactions endpoint owns
everything from the moment a schedule releases onward.

tags.name: Fields
tags.description:
Fields are the labels, budgets, departments, and other tags a business
uses to categorize spend. Endpoints in this group return the field
catalog: every field's id, name, type, cardinality, status, and -
for choice fields - its option list.

tags.name: Accounts Payable
tags.description: Accounts Payable covers counterparties and bills.

get.description:
Returns cards belonging to the business.
Canceled and expired cards remain available in unfiltered lists so
their stable IDs can be joined to historical transactions.

`spending_limit_type`: How the spending limit is enforced. High
utilization means the next charge can decline. `daily`, `weekly`,
`monthly` and `quarterly` reset on Eastern Time (America/New_York)
calendar boundaries. `annual` resets on the anniversary of when the
limit took effect, not on a calendar boundary. The `fixed` is a
lifetime ceiling that does not reset. `single_use` is spent after one
use.

`current_spend`: Pending plus settled spend in the current limit
window; null when the card has no limit or current spend is
unavailable.

`spend_period_start`: Start of the current spending-limit window,
computed in Eastern Time (America/New_York). Null when unavailable - no
current spend, or the window could not be determined. For fixed and
single_use this is when the lifetime total began.

`spend_period_end`: Exclusive end of the current spending-limit window,
computed in Eastern Time (America/New_York). Null when the limit does
not reset (fixed, single_use), when current_spend is null, or when the
window could not be determined.

`shipment`: Omitted until enabled for the business, and
omitted for virtual cards or physical cards without a recorded
shipment. Otherwise contains the latest carrier-reported delivery
state, including `status`, `tracking_number`, `estimated_delivery_at`,
and `delivered_at`. Shipment status is distinct from the top-level card
lifecycle status.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Filter by one or more cardholder user IDs.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by one or more card types.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by one or more card lifecycle statuses.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of cards to return. Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor from page.next_page_token in the previous response.
Omit it for the first page.

200.description: Returns a page of cards

patch.description:
Sets or clears the user-supplied note on a transaction. Notes are
accepted only on the following `TransactionType` values: `ach_credit`,
`ach_debit`, `card_credit`, `card_debit`, `card_refund`,
`check_deposit`, `check_payment`, `credit_repayment`,
`credit_repayment_refund`, `internal_transfer`, `international_wire_in`,
`international_wire_out`, `savings_interest`, `treasury_interest`,
`wire_in`, and `wire_out`; any other type rejects the request with a
contract violation. An empty string clears the note. The note is
published to the same stream the in-app note drawer writes to, so a
subsequent read may briefly return the previous value until the read
service consumes the update.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Transaction identifier returned in the transaction `id` field

200.description: Confirms the note was updated

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of finalized statements for the
business, newest close date first. Spans all statement
types and all accounts in one aggregated surface. The account_id filter
selects complete statements that include at least one requested account;
it does not limit the accounts included in a matched statement.
Supported statement types are account, credit, and treasury. Statements
are not currently generated for rewards accounts.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description:
Return complete statements that include at least one requested
account. Multiple values use OR semantics. A matched statement's
accounts array and PDF may include additional accounts belonging to
the business.
Credit statements cover the business's credit line and cannot be
filtered by account_id. Returns 400 with "you cannot filter credit
statements by account_id" if statement_type includes credit or all
requested account IDs belong to credit accounts. Mixed credit and
non-credit account filters otherwise retain matching account and
treasury statements. Rewards accounts have no statements.

get.description:
Returns the field catalog for the authenticated business:
the labels, budgets, departments, and other fields used to
categorize spend.

Each field carries an id (the field's stable id), a name, a
type (choice for a fixed set of options, or freetext for an
open text value), a cardinality (one_to_one for a single value,
or one_to_many for several), a status (active, or retired when
archived and hidden from new tagging), and is_system_managed
(true when Rho owns the field, such as the system Department
field). color_hex is an optional display color. A choice field
carries its options nested under options; each option has its
own id, name, status, and optional color_hex. A freetext field
has an empty options list.

The catalog is paginated over fields, ordered by id. Options are
not paginated: every option of a returned field is included.

parameters.name: include_retired
parameters.description:
Include retired (archived) fields and options alongside active
ones. Defaults to false, which returns only active ones.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of fields per page; max 100.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from page.next_page_token in the previous response.

200.description: Returns a page of the business field catalog

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
A unique key of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters, generated once per
intended action and reused on every retry. UUID v4 is recommended.
Keys are case-sensitive. Surrounding spaces are ignored.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeded the 1 MiB limit

TooManyRequests.description: Request rejected because a Rho API rate limit was exceeded

Retry-After.description:
Suggested delay in seconds before retrying. A positive value should
be honored. A value of zero means that no fixed cooldown has been
applied and does not guarantee that an immediate retry will succeed.
If the header is zero, use exponential backoff with jitter.

CardDeclineReasonCode.description: Why a card authorization was declined.

RecommendedActionCode.description: Stable identifier for something a person can do about a decline.

description.description: The action as a sentence, matching the decline email's wording.

explanation.description:
One or two sentences a person can read, matching what the decline
email tells the cardholder. A constant per `code`, carrying no
transaction data.

recommended_actions.description:
What to do next, in the order to try it. Empty when there's no
customer-side remedy.

amount.description:
The amount of this authorization attempt, which is independent of
the transaction's own amount.

reasons.description:
Why the attempt was declined. Several reasons can apply to one
attempt - a card can hit its own limit and a blocked category in
the same authorization. Never empty.

declined_authorizations.description:
Declined authorization attempts on this card transaction, oldest
first. Empty when the attempts were read and none were declined.

RepaymentCadence.description: How card spend is settled: daily means each day's spend is repaid the next day; monthly means spend settles once per statement period.

account_id.description: Credit account this program posts to. Omitted when unavailable.

cashback_rate.description: Current cashback rate as a percentage, such as 1.15 for 1.15%.

credit_limit.description: Current credit limit. Omitted when unavailable.

archived_at.description: When the program was archived. Omitted for an active program.

account_id.description: Credit account this program posts to. Omitted when unavailable.

balance_due_date.description: Calendar date the amount due must be repaid. Omitted when unavailable.

period_start_date.description: Inclusive first calendar date of the related repayment period. Omitted when unavailable.

period_end_date.description: Inclusive last calendar date of the related repayment period. Omitted when unavailable.

as_of.description: Time when the live balance was computed.

next_page_token.description: Pass as page_token to fetch the next page; null on the last page

CardType.description: Physical or virtual form of the card.

CardShipmentStatus.description:
Latest carrier-reported shipment state. `created` means the shipment
record exists but carrier movement has not been reported. `in_transit`
and `out_for_delivery` describe carrier progress. `delivery_delayed`
and `delivery_canceled` report exceptions; a delay does not change the
top-level card lifecycle status. `delivered` means delivery was
reported complete. `unknown` means the carrier could not classify the
shipment state.

CardSpendingLimitType.description:
How the spending limit is enforced. High utilization means the next
charge can decline. `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` and `quarterly` reset
on Eastern Time (America/New_York) calendar boundaries. `annual` resets
on the anniversary of when the limit took effect, not on a calendar
boundary. The `fixed` is a lifetime ceiling that does not reset.
`single_use` is spent after one use.

user_id.description: Stable global identifier for the cardholder.

second_line.description: Suite, unit, or second address line.

Merchant.description: A merchant restriction identified by its human-readable name.

CardShipment.description: Latest carrier-reported delivery details for a physical card.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number; null until one is assigned.

estimated_delivery_at.description: Carrier-estimated delivery time; null when unavailable.

delivered_at.description: Carrier-reported delivery time; null until delivered.

Card.description:
A physical or virtual card belonging to the business.
Merchant controls use either the blocked fields or the allowed fields,
never both.

id.description: Stable global card identifier referenced by transactions.

name.description: User-editable name assigned to the card.

last_4.description: Last four PAN digits, including leading zeroes.

spending_limit.description: Configured spending limit; null when the card has no limit.

spending_limit_type.description: How the spending limit is enforced; null when the card has no limit.

current_spend.description: Pending plus settled spend in the current limit window; null when the card has no limit or current spend is unavailable.

pending_spend.description: Pending portion of current_spend; null when current_spend is null or the pending breakdown is unavailable.

spend_period_start.description: Start of the current spending-limit window, computed in Eastern Time (America/New_York). Null when unavailable - no current spend, or the window could not be determined. For fixed and single_use this is when the lifetime total began.

spend_period_end.description: Exclusive end of the current spending-limit window, computed in Eastern Time (America/New_York). Null when the limit does not reset (fixed, single_use), when current_spend is null, or when the window could not be determined.

usage_starts_at.description: Earliest time at which the card may be used; null when unrestricted.

usage_ends_at.description: Latest time at which the card may be used; null when unrestricted.

billing_address.description: Billing address used for card verification.

shipping_address.description: Physical-card delivery address; null for virtual cards or when not recorded.

shipment.description:
Latest shipment details. Omitted while the field is not enabled
for the business or when no shipment has been
recorded.

blocked_categories.description: Categories declined at authorization time. Present only for a block list.

allowed_categories.description: Only categories permitted at authorization time. Present only for an allow list.

blocked_merchants.description: Merchants declined at authorization time. Present only for a block list.

allowed_merchants.description: Only merchants permitted at authorization time. Present only for an allow list.

note.description: The note as it should read afterwards. An empty string clears the note.

FieldValue.description: A field and its applied value, including system-managed fields such as Department and Labels.

value_id.description: Stable selected-option ID; null for a free-text value.

money_movement_id.description: Identifier shared by transaction entries belonging to the same money movement

note.description: Text added to the transaction in Rho by a user. Editable. Omitted when unset.

memo.description: Text that arrived with the transaction, from the bank, payment provider or generated by Rho. Read-only. Omitted when unset.

card_id.description: Card transactions only; null for all other transaction types

tracking_number.description:
Payment network identifier used to trace the outbound transaction:
ACH NACHA trace number, or wire IMAD/OMAD. MT103 reference numbers
are not returned.

attachments.description: Stable attachment descriptors; signed URLs are resolved on demand

lines.description:
Line-item splits - the rows a user creates when dividing this
transaction across categories in the Rho app.

An array only when the transaction is split, and then it has two
or more entries. Null when the transaction is not split or its
split state is unknown, so null does not guarantee the transaction
is unsplit.

Entry order is not significant and is not guaranteed stable
between reads.

allOf.description: This line's share of the transaction amount, in account currency

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

allOf.description: Total amount collected across paid invoices

last_invoice_id.description: Identifier of the most recent invoice for this customer

deleted_at.description: Set when the customer is deleted; null otherwise

InvoicingInvoiceStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an invoice in Invoicing.

InvoicingInvoiceAccountingSyncStatus.description:
Accounting sync state for an invoice. object_changed means the invoice
was previously synced but has changed since the last successful sync.

InvoicingInvoicePaymentType.description: How an invoice payment was recorded.

InvoicingInvoiceExternalPaymentMethod.description: External payment method when payment type is external.

InvoicingInvoiceActivityType.description: Activity event recorded against an invoice.

allOf.description: Unit price before line-level discount and tax

tax_rate.description: When null, the invoice-level tax_rate applies.

allOf.description: Line total after discount, before tax

paid_at.description: User-provided payment date; set for external payments

transaction_id.description: Transaction identifier when type is received_in_account

user_id.description: User associated with the activity when available

emails.description: Email addresses associated with the activity

note.description: Invoice note shown to the customer

due_date.description: Invoice due date; null when not set

file_id.description: Identifier of the attached invoice PDF when present.

accounting_synced_at.description: Last successful accounting sync timestamp when present

account_id.description:
Account these figures belong to. Null for credit statements, which
are not tied to a deposit account.

allOf.description: Balance as of the start of period_start
Balance as of the close date (period_end), the reconciliation anchor
Sum of credits posted in the period
Sum of debits posted in the period

repayment_date.description: Credit statements only; date repayment is/was due for the period

spending.description: Credit statements only; total card spend in the period

repayments.description: Credit statements only; repayments applied in the period

cashback.description: Credit statements only; cashback earned in the period

period_start.description: First day of the statement period (inclusive)

period_end.description: Close date of the statement period (inclusive)

available_at.description: Timestamp the finalized statement became available

pdf_url.description:
A short-lived signed download URL for the PDF, valid for up to
15 minutes, or `null` when the document cannot be linked. If the
link lapses, re-fetch the statement with `GET /statements/{id}` to
obtain a fresh URL.

accounts.description:
Per-account figures. One entry per account for account and treasury
statements, which may span multiple checking/savings accounts; a
single entry for credit statements.

statement_type.description: The kind of statement (account, credit or treasury)

CashflowGrouping.description: Groups cash flow by day, week, or month.

bucket_start.description: Start of the period represented by this bucket.

buckets.description: Cash-flow periods ordered by start time.

counterparty_id.description: Counterparty identifier when available from the transaction data.

counterparty_name.description: Counterparty name when available from the transaction data.

counterparty_logo_url.description: Counterparty logo URL when available from the transaction data.

tin.description: EIN / business tax id, masked to last 4 digits

top_inflows.description: Counterparties ranked by money flowing into the business.

top_outflows.description: Counterparties ranked by money flowing out of the business.

MembershipStatus.description:
Membership lifecycle of the user within this business: `invited` (invite
sent, not yet accepted), `active` (accepted), or `removed`. Distinct from
`user_status`, which describes the user's account rather than this
membership.

UserStatus.description:
Status of the user's Rho account: `blocked` when the account is blocked,
`active` otherwise. A blocked user still holds their membership, so they
are returned by this endpoint.

first_name.description: User's first name. Omitted when Rho does not hold one.

last_name.description: User's last name. Omitted when Rho does not hold one.

email.description: User's email. Omitted when Rho does not hold one.

phone_number.description: User's phone number. Omitted when Rho does not hold one.

role_name.description: The member's role (group) name in your business.

ReimbursementPaymentStatus.description: Unknown is used when the payment state cannot be named.

original_amount.description: Amount in the submitted currency; null when no separate amount was recorded.

transaction_date.description: UTC calendar date of the spend.

attendee_user_ids.description: Tagged users in recorded order; empty when nobody was tagged.

ScheduledTransactionPaymentType.description: The money-movement rail a scheduled transaction uses once it releases.

ScheduledTransactionFrequency.description:
How often the schedule repeats. semi_monthly is anchored to the 1st and
15th; weekly, monthly and yearly to the same weekday or calendar day.
one_time releases exactly once.

ScheduledTransactionEndConditionType.description:
How a repeating schedule stops. never means it repeats until someone
cancels it.

ScheduledTransactionCounterparty.description: The counterparty a scheduled transaction pays.

id.description: Stable counterparty identifier included in the schedule response.

ScheduledTransactionAccountReference.description: A bank account held by the business.

id.description: Stable identifier of the bank account the payment is drawn from.

ScheduledTransactionUserReference.description: A team member of the business.

Stable identifier of the bill represented by this reference.

ScheduledTransactionEndCondition.description: How a repeating schedule stops producing occurrences.

end_date.description:
Exclusive: the schedule stops before this date, so an occurrence
that would land exactly on it does not fire. The last release is on
the preceding scheduled date. Set only when type is end_date.

occurrence_count.description: Total occurrences the schedule runs for. Set only when type is occurrence_count.

ScheduledTransactionSchedule.description: When and how often a scheduled transaction releases.

next_release_date.description:
When this schedule next releases. null once it has permanently
stopped producing occurrences - its single release for one_time, or
its end condition reached.

failed.description:
true when a recurring schedule has stopped executing its
occurrences, as distinct from one that completed normally or was
canceled. Always false for one_time.

ScheduledTransaction.description: A future-dated payment or transfer, one-time or recurring.

id.description: Stable schedule identifier, unique across all businesses. Safe to use as a dedupe key.

ExpensePolicyRequirementsStatus.description: Whether the expense satisfies policy requirements.

ExpenseOutOfPolicyStatus.description: Whether policy compliance was determined automatically or set manually.

kind.description: Kind of policy requirement not yet satisfied (e.g. receipt).

missing_requirements.description:
Requirements the expense has not yet satisfied. Empty unless
`requirements_status` is `needs_details`; it may also be empty when
requirement details are unavailable.

field_name.description: Display name of the category attribute at change time.

value_id.description: Stable identifier for the selected tag value. Omitted for freeform tags.

file_id.description: Stable identifier for the attached file.

automatically_matched.description: True when the attachment was associated automatically.

attached_at.description: Timestamp when the file was attached to the expense.

updated_at.description: Timestamp the expense was last updated.

status_updated_at.description: Timestamp the approval status was last changed.

settlement_date.description: Timestamp the underlying spend settled, when applicable.

Deprecated - use `fields`, which carries the same values in the
format shared with transactions, cards, and reimbursements.
Removed when Expenses leaves Beta.

fields.description: Applied field values, including system-managed fields such as Department and Labels.

attachments.description: Receipt or document files attached to the expense.

Previous display value recorded by the activity feed. Its format
depends on the changed field and is not normalized to the

New display value recorded by the activity feed. Its format depends

actor_user_id.description: User who triggered the activity entry. Omitted for automatically generated entries.

automated.description: True when the activity was generated automatically.

changes.description: Field-level changes recorded by this activity entry.

file_id.description: Stable identifier for the attached file.

FieldType.description:
Shape of the field: `choice` (a fixed set of options) or `freetext`
(an open text value).

FieldCardinality.description:
How many values may apply to one object at once: `one_to_one` (a single
value) or `one_to_many` (multiple values).

FieldStatus.description:
Lifecycle state: `active`, or `retired` when the field is archived
and hidden from new tagging. Retired fields stay readable so
historical values still resolve.

color_hex.description: Hex display color, for example "#1A2B3C". Omitted when no color is set.

is_system_managed.description:
True when Rho manages this field (for example the system
Department field) rather than the business defining it.

color_hex.description: Hex display color, for example "#1A2B3C". Omitted when no color is set.

options.description: The choices of a choice field. Empty for a freetext field.

CounterpartyStatus.description: Derived display status of the counterparty.

W9Status.description: W-9 collection status for the counterparty.

CounterpartyPaymentMethodType.description: Non-sensitive payment method type on file for a counterparty.

CounterpartyPaymentMethod.description:
A non-sensitive payment method on file for a counterparty, used to
disburse payments. At most one method per counterparty is the default.

id.description:
Identifier of this payment method record. Always present, and `null`
for `single_use_card`, which is minted per payment and so has no
stored record to reference.

is_default.description: Whether this is the counterparty's default payment method.

description.description: Human-readable label for the payment method when available.

bank_name.description: Bank name when applicable to the method.

currency.description: Settlement currency as an ISO 4217 code (for example "USD").

country_code.description: Country of the payment method as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

address.description:
Full address when applicable (check shipping or international
beneficiary address).

Counterparty.description: A supplier or payee owned by the authenticated business.

nickname.description: Optional display nickname for the counterparty.

phone_number.description: Contact phone number in E.164 format when on file.

registration_country_code.description: Country of the counterparty as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

payment_methods.description: Non-archived payment methods on file for this counterparty.

BillStatus.description:
Combined lifecycle state of a bill, folding underlying bill state,
payment state, and approval stage into a single value. Roughly in
lifecycle order:

`draft` - not yet submitted for payment.
`missing_payment_details` - submitted, but cannot proceed until the
payment details it needs are on file.
`awaiting_approval` - pending one or more approvals.
`ready_for_payment` - approved and payable, not yet scheduled.
`scheduled` - payment scheduled for a future date.
`pending_payment` - payment in flight, not yet settled.
`paid` - payment settled.
`failed_payment` - payment failed.
`archived` - the bill or its payment was archived.
`other` - a state that does not map to any value above. Treat it as a
catch-all rather than a stable state: new states surface here before
they get their own value.

A bill does not necessarily pass through every state, and the order is
not guaranteed - do not infer progress from it.

BillLine.description:

amount.

Settled payment transaction for this bill. Set only once the bill
